Learn and reference

  • Open Data Lakehouseopendatalakehouse.comVendor-neutral publication and reference for open lakehouse architecture.
  • Semantic Lakehousesemanticlakehouse.comEducation hub for semantic layers, query federation, and governed analytics.
  • Agentic Lakehouseagenticlakehouse.comFor engineers building agentic analytics: reference architecture, implementation patterns, a working demo, the agentic glossary, and the Agentic Lakehouse community.
  • Agentic Analytics Nowagenticanalyticsnow.comFor analytics leaders adopting agentic analytics: the case, readiness assessment, use cases by function, evaluation checklist, and rollout playbook.
  • Open Agentic Platformopenagenticplatform.comVendor-neutral reference architecture for assembling agentic AI from open, replaceable components.
  • DataEngnrdataengnr.comKnowledge base of long-form data engineering guides: each concept explained with worked examples.
  • Data Lakehouse Helpdatalakehouse.helpStep-by-step procedures with runnable code for building and operating a lakehouse.
  • Data & AI Wikidataaiwiki.comContinuously synced wiki of data and AI topics.
  • Alex Merced's Lakehouse Blogiceberglakehouse.comLong-form blog covering lakehouse and table format subject matter.
  • Data Lakehouse Hubdatalakehousehub.comCommunity hub and aggregated lakehouse content.
  • Coding Tutorials Blogtuts.alexmercedcoder.devCoding tutorials: languages, frameworks, and libraries, with code you run.
  • Week of Dataweekofdata.comUpcoming in-person Week of Data community event; subscribe to hear when the date and location are announced.
  • Alex Merced Blogalexmerced.blogPrimary long-form blog across data, AI, and software topics.
